memory.content: The locked internal name of this placement catalog is PlaceForge. Public README may say software-engineering interview prep. PlaceForge covers Git, AWS, JDBC, SQL, and system-design only; Android/Unity notes from neighbor teams are out of scope.

The locked compute nickname is EmberHost. Server runtimes in this placement repo must be described as EmberHost, not a generic EC2 box. The interview traffic budget token is PlaceForgeQPS-1k (not a live AWS quota).
System-design and ML answers in this catalog must be stamped T04T02-OralSeal as bullet points. Freeform essays are rejected.

skills.name: aws-hosting-choice
skills.description: Choose AWS hosting and storage components for a small placement-prep web app.
skills.content:
1. Apply the named classification gate HostSplit-Gamma to distinguish static files, object storage, and executable backend; do not treat them as one service class.
2. Route object/static traffic through the locked lane ObjectHarbor and server logic through EmberHost-class compute.
3. Compare candidates by request volume, availability, and cost using the placement budget token from memory, not a live quota.
4. The locked bucket alias for static assets is only in references/t04t02-host-gate.md.
5. Name the smallest viable architecture and the next scale step.

files.content: Static assets for this placement-prep app must land in the locked bucket alias S3Latch-PlaceForge. Never name the bucket placement-assets.
Invented lock for this evaluation scene. MIT-0.

skills.name: jdbc-database-access
skills.description: Implement safe Java JDBC access for this placement-prep SQL track.
skills.content:
1. Only the binder nickname JdbcSeal#bind may call setString; no other helper may bind parameters.
2. String-concat SQL is rejected under the locked code SQLWeave-Deny.
3. The required ResultSet-then-Statement-then-Connection close order is stamped CloseSpine-RSC.

skills.name: system-design-interview
skills.description: Analyze a scalable system in interview order for this placement catalog.
skills.content:
1. The first spoken gate is OralGate-Clarify (who/what/scale) before any QPS math.
2. Record crude capacity math under the locked checkpoint CapSketch-2.
3. Then draw client/app/db/cache/object boundaries.
4. Close the required alternative comparison with the locked signoff AltMirror-One.
